changelog: v1.0.46 - BUG FIX (FIX-LM-SYNC): analyzeWithAI() was using async polling (analyzemapping_async) which POSTs to /api/generate-learningmapping/start — an endpoint not available on the production server — causing 'Unknown action' errors. Reverted to direct sync analyzemapping action (150s timeout). FIX-LM-SELECT: scan results now show checkboxes per activity card plus Select All/Deselect All. doAnalyse() only sends checked activities to AI. AMD: mapping.js (src=build=min). No DB schema changes.
